text:
Predicates:
FinancialAid(x) ::: x is a person who receives financial aid.
ProveHardship(x) ::: x proves economic hardship.
SingleParentFamily(x) ::: x lives in a single-parent family.
FewResources(x) ::: x has few resources available.
LivesInFamily(x, y) ::: x lives in family y.
Applying(x, y) ::: x is applying to y.
TestGRE(x) ::: x is taking the GRE test.
Premises:
Tom ∈ LivesInFamily(Tom, SingleParentFamily) ::: Tom lives in a single-parent family.
Tom ∈ ProveHardship(Tom) ::: Tom can prove economic hardship.
Tom ∈ FewResources(Tom) ::: Tom has few resources available.
Tom ∈ Applying(Tom, GRE) ::: Tom is applying to take the GRE test.
Conclusion:
¬∃x (FinancialAid(x)) ::: No one taking the GRE test has financial aid provided to them by something.
